messages:
Ava (PM): FYI — competitor 'NovaAI' shipped a lightweight 'fast-detect' filter today. It overlaps ~40% of our planned Early-Filter work. Do we reprioritize for parity or keep pushing our eval-driven quality differentiator? Need a decision for next sprint. https://redwood-internal/notes/early-filter

Diego (Eng): what's the implementation delta? parity vs our plan?

Jin (Research): quick read: their approach is a coarse ensemble + heuristic thresholds. Our evals show lower FPR but higher latency on our current prototype.

Diego (Eng): rough guesstimate: parity path is ~2w eng + 1w infra to add the quantized runtime. Our quality path is 3–4w + extra eval cycles.

Lina (Solutions): multiple enterprise customers pinged us asking for 'fast filter' to reduce token spend. There's a revenue signal (5 customers, ~$30k ARR).

Sam (VP Product): proposing a decision framework: 1) customer revenue impact 2) dev effort 3) differentiation delta 4) ops cost. If revenue > $20k and effort < 3w -> bump priority.

Rix (Design): design-wise parity UI is trivial. Biggest risk is confusing customers if we ship two different default behaviors.

Ava (PM): can we do a timeboxed spike to validate parity approach perf vs our quality baseline? 1 week dev + 1 week for a Canary sounds reasonable.

Diego (Eng): I can carve out 1 engineer for the 1w spike, but not full implementation. Would need additional eng for canary rollout.

Jin (Research): I can produce an eval harness and a small prompt set to compare FPR/latency within 3 days.

Lina (Solutions): I'll surface the tradeoff doc to the 5 customers for preference check and capture any must-have constraints.

Sam (VP Product): decision: run a 1w spike this sprint. If parity meets latency target (<50ms p50) and cost delta <20% we'll scope a 2-week parity story. Otherwise we keep the quality path and consider a degraded 'fast-mode' flag for customers.

Ava (PM): noted. Action items: Diego - spike (assignee), Jin - eval harness, Lina - customer check, Rix - copy for UI toggle, Sam - criteria doc.

release-bot: Created ticket RI-5321 and added to product backlog: https://redwood-internal/tickets/RI-5321

Diego (Eng): ack, starting spike tomorrow. :rocket:

Lina (Solutions): will ping customers today. :eyes:

Jin (Research): eval harness ETA EOD Thu.

Rix (Design): prepping a small UI toggle mock by Fri.

Ava (PM): we'll reconvene Wed 10am to decide. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
